## What's new

- Dynamic scenes can optionally stop when any target light is turned off or its color is changed outside the scene.
- Dynamic scene service calls now carry Home Assistant contexts so scene-originated color changes are not mistaken for manual changes.
- Brightness-only changes are ignored by manual-change detection.
- Favorites are now stored persistently per Home Assistant user instead of only in browser local storage.
- Existing browser favorites are migrated automatically on first use.
- Added favorite management actions for add, remove, and toggle operations.
- The Scene Presets UI now exposes the manual-stop option and shows its state on active dynamic scenes.

This release includes the rebuilt frontend bundle and backend tests for the new behavior.
